# The Restoration Group

> 24/7 water, fire & mold damage restoration across New Jersey.

The Restoration Group (The Restoration Group) is a professional restoration contractor serving Kenilworth, NJ and surrounding areas since 2021. We provide 24/7 emergency response for water, fire, mold, storm, biohazard, and reconstruction services. Phone: (855) 650-7422 · Email: .

- **Founded:** 2021
